summary: All 4 production blockers fixed and verified: req.auth mapping (resolveAuthContext helper replaces all req.user references), ShopifyProvider self-registration (providerRegistry.register at bottom of shopify.ts), ENCRYPTION_KEY production guard (throws on startup when unset in production), and RLS table list (project_integrations + integration_tools added to enable-rls.mjs). All 3 secondary bugs fixed: refundUsage moved to top-level import, RBAC role check uses membership.role from req.auth, Shopify safeFetch has 10s AbortController timeout. Audit log entries now include requestId, organizationId, and durationMs. Verification test suite (integrations-2e-verification.test.ts) exists with 20 assertions — 20 PASSED, 0 FAILED, 0 SKIPPED. No widget files touched by integration commits. No duplicate systems created. TypeScript compiles without errors (tsc --noEmit exit code 0). FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 status fields are 'completed'. Three non-blocking gaps remain: CONNECTING/DISCONNECTED integration states and the AUTHORIZED tool lifecycle state are still unimplemented (spec gap, not a runtime failure), and live Shopify execution is UNVERIFIED (no credentials in .env).
